why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open di.xyz/check-in and connect a wallet. "First login requires a free signature. No gas or asset transfer."
Switch the wallet to BNB Chain and keep a little BNB for gas.
Press the on-chain check-in and confirm the transaction. It sends no BNB to DI, only gas.
Repeat once a day until you reach 30 check-ins. They don't have to be in a row.
Link your X account for 100 points, and do the X and Telegram tasks if you want.
Watch DI's site and X for the badge claim and the Genesis mint.
costs: Signing in is free. Each check-in costs only gas: transactions we read on 21 November paid about 0.000002 to 0.000007 BNB each, so 30 check-ins cost well under 0.001 BNB. If the wallet is empty: "Add enough BNB to cover network gas, then try again." The Genesis mint price isn't published, so the whitelist may lead to a paid mint. risks: No terms of service or privacy policy are published, and no excluded countries or age limit are stated. No team member is named.
